# KiCad 8 corpus fixtures

Unmodified upstream QA source files from the KiCad 8.0.0 release tag. Original authors and licensing remain those of the [KiCad source mirror](https://github.com/KiCad/kicad-source-mirror/tree/8.0.0). See provenance.json for exact URLs and hashes. Their old saved-format headers have deliberately not been replaced with synthetic KiCad 8 headers.
